description: React component for the backstage sidebar in Mattermost, managing rendering of custom emoji and integrations with permission checks.

classes.name: BackstageSidebar
classes.description: React component class for rendering the backstage sidebar with permission-based sections.

methods.name: renderCustomEmoji
methods.description: Renders the custom emoji category if enabled and permitted.

methods.name: renderIntegrations
methods.description: Renders the integrations categories including webhooks, commands, OAuth apps, bots, and OAuth connections based on permissions and feature flags.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main render method that outputs the sidebar containing custom emoji and integrations sections.
